lead.en: Turn relationships into graph models, prove tree and traversal properties, order dependencies, and explore a finite protocol with explicit safety assumptions.
lead.zh: 把关系建成图模型，证明树与遍历性质，排列依赖，并在明确安全假设下探索有限协议。

prerequisites.en: Modules 03, 04, and 06: relations, induction and invariants, and operation-count models. Python lists, dictionaries, loops, and functions are used in the labs.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 03、04 与 06：关系、归纳与不变式、操作计数模型。实验使用 Python 列表、字典、循环与函数。

en: Choose directed or undirected graph conventions and compare adjacency representations.
Prove the degree-sum identity and the finite-tree edge theorem.
Explain BFS reachability and its unweighted shortest-path certificate.
Construct a topological order or a directed cycle witness.
State a finite protocol invariant and explain the limits of exhaustive checking.
zh: 选择有向或无向图约定并比较邻接表示。
证明度数和恒等式与有限树边数定理。
解释 BFS 可达性及无权最短路径证书。
构造拓扑序或有向环见证。
声明有限协议不变式并解释穷尽检查的限制。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and translate the same graph between representations.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，把同一图在不同表示间转换。

text.en: Build lists and a matrix; check degrees and the isolated vertex.
text.zh: 建立列表与矩阵，检查度数和孤立点。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4; prove the leaf and BFS claims.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，证明叶子与 BFS 命题。

text.en: Read the selected graph and traversal notes.
text.zh: 阅读所选图与遍历讲义。

text.en: Explain why BFS counts edges and DFS need not minimise them.
text.zh: 解释 BFS 为何计边最短而 DFS 不保证最短。

text.en: Read Section 5; construct an order and a cycle witness.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节，构造顺序与环见证。

text.en: Check traversals, shortest-path labels, and Kahn's algorithm.
text.zh: 检查遍历、最短路径标记与 Kahn 算法。

title.zh: 有限状态安全与模型限制

text.en: Read Section 6 and step through the BFS explorer.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节并逐步使用 BFS 探索器。

text.en: Find the faulty timeout witness and verify the bounded repair.
text.zh: 找到错误超时见证并验证有界修复。

text.en: Complete the choices and written traversal argument.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面遍历论证。

text.en: Read the state-machine selection and complete the exit check.
text.zh: 阅读状态机选段并完成结业检查。
